title: finding(app-shell,components): a stored page's KIND is written straight into the SDUI node discriminator and nothing declares the coupling — the trap that has now mis-framed objectui#9263 and objectui#9576
body:
Filed by the `domain:spec` @ objectui execution seat (session `session_01VCpmqvacV4BypY48QdoxcE`), carrying a **class (c)** finding handed back by the dev on objectui#9263 — a trap that makes an author (human or AI) write metadata the runtime silently mishandles. ⭐ It has now produced **two mis-framed cards**, which is why it is filed rather than noted.

## The trap

A stored page document's `type` field is the **spec page KIND** — one of `record` / `home` / `app` / `utility` / `list`. `packages/app-shell/src/views/PageView.tsx` writes it **verbatim into the SchemaNode discriminator** that `ComponentRegistry` dispatches on, with no fallback for an unregistered value:

```js
type: (page as any).type || 'page',
pageType: (page as any).type
```

⇒ The five `ComponentRegistry.register(..., PageRenderer, ...)` calls in `packages/components/src/renderers/layout/page.tsx` exist **because of that line** — they are the five page kinds, registered so the passthrough resolves. It is why one of them is labelled "App Page".

## Why it is a trap and not just a design

**Nothing declares the coupling.** Two vocabularies — the spec's page kinds and the SDUI node-type registry — are joined by a two-line mapping, and the only thing that says so is a **comment**. So a reader auditing the registry sees five names registered with no schema declaring them, and correctly concludes "registered but never declared" — a real defect shape in this repository, with its own cards.

That reading has now been acted on twice:

- **objectui#9263** ruled letter A (remove the `app` registration) and reached a draft PR before the dev's own later measurement falsified it. Six kind-`app` documents in ObjectStack's own showcase would have stopped rendering, painting OBJUI-001 in place of the page. The card is back with the maintainer.
- **objectui#9576** was sitting in `pm:queue` proposing the same disposition for `utility` / `home` / `record`. Same route, and the same census pass counted **8** kind-`home` and **3** kind-`record` documents. It has been moved to `pm:blocked` behind objectui#9263.

⇒ Two cards, independently reasoned, both wrong in the same way, because the evidence that would have corrected them is not declared anywhere either of them looked.

## ⚠️ What this card asks — and what it does NOT

It asks that the **coupling be recorded somewhere an auditor of either vocabulary will meet it**. ⛔ It does **not** propose the repair: making page kinds stop riding the node discriminator (`PageView` mapping kind to `type: 'page'` plus `pageType`) changes every stored document's render path and is a far larger change than either card above. That shape is one of the options in front of the maintainer on objectui#9263 and is ⛔ not this card's to pick.

## Also recorded, from the same hand-back — the gap that let it through

No test in this repository renders a stored page document through the **real** `SchemaRenderer`. The only `PageView` test mocks `SchemaRenderer` out entirely and uses a page of kind `page`. That is why 2702 green component tests said nothing about a change that breaks six shipped pages.

⭐ Sharper still, and worth reading before anyone picks this up: `packages/components/src/__tests__/page-single-h1.test.tsx` carries a fixture documented as *"The showcase master-detail page, reduced to the parts that render headings"*, with `name: 'showcase_project_workspace'` and `label: 'New Project + Tasks'` — an **in-repo model of the very document that broke** — authored `type: 'app'`. On objectui#9263 it was edited to `type: 'page'` so it would keep passing. A fixture that mirrors a real document is **evidence about that document**; editing it to agree with a change destroys the signal instead of reading it.

A missing test is none of the three filing classes, so it is recorded here against this trap rather than filed on its own. Whoever takes the objectui#9263 decision will have to close it to prove whatever they choose.

`pm:queue`, unassigned. ⛔ No serial constraint, but ⛔ do not act ahead of objectui#9263's re-ruling — the shape of any repair here depends on it.
